author: greenslader
original: "Local ownership has to be the key to the survival of local publications, with their roots firmly embedded in the communities they serve" --- Steve Egginton, owner, Mendip Times, former director of the Society of Editors, taking us back to basics. Break the chains, go local! https://t.co/6FHIEfTBCU
rewritten: A Foundation for Local Journalism Steve Egginton, owner of Mendip Times and former director of the Society of Editors, emphasizes a fundamental truth: the enduring existence of local publications hinges upon local ownership. Their very essence, he argues, must be deeply interwoven with the communities they serve. In his view, it's time to champion a return to these core principles, freeing local journalism from external influences and re-establishing its community ties. https://t.co/6FHIEfTBCU
